Don-Jo KP-12x28-630 12" x 28" Satin Stainless Steel Kick Plate

Custom size 12" x 28" (NOT RETURNABLE). Made of .050" thick high quality solid stainless steel for longevity. Packaged with stainless steel mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications of Don-Jo KP-12x28-630 Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Plate Height: 12"
  • Plate Width: 28"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Mounting Holes: 12
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with Stainless Mounting Screws

*Sold Individually.
